annotations.title: Polish banking sector: profit, loans and deposits (KNF)

description: Use for the profit of Polish banks as a sector, net interest income, bank tax paid on profit, impaired housing and consumer loans and household deposits. Do not use for the data of one bank. Polish banking sector from KNF monthly data (FINREP): net profit year-to-date with change vs the same months a year earlier, net profit in the latest month and over 12 months, gross profit, tax as % of gross profit, net interest and fee income, operating costs vs income, impairment, the finwire index finwire_bank_interest_share (net interest income / total operating income over 12 months: how much bank income depends on interest rates), household housing and consumer loan portfolios with impaired loans (IFRS 9 stage 3) and household deposits. Group: whole sector (default), commercial banks, branches of foreign credit institutions or cooperative banks. Amounts in PLN. Informational data about the sector, not about one bank and not investment advice.

history.description: Number of past months in the summary, default 6.
